name: TermGrade Band-Central
summary: Solve containerised Linux terminal tasks in a bash tool-calling scaffold; a hidden pytest verifier decides pass or fail.
good_for: tasks selected at 0.50 base pass rate

reward.note: Each task's tests/test.sh runs pytest in a verifier venv; reward.txt holds 1 on pass. Test files are copied in only at scoring time.

run:
from datasets import load_dataset
train = load_dataset("ai-and/termgrade-bandcentral-gemma4-31b-bash", "train151")["train"]
print(train[0]["extra_info"]["verl_band_pass_rate"])    # 0.5 for every training task
needs: Docker and a locally built base image
validated: Every task carries a measured base pass rate and a reference solution that is run against its verifier.

name: TermGrade Environments
summary: Complete executable Linux terminal tasks in a container; a pytest verifier checks the result, with measured pass rates for six models.

reward.note: Each task ships a pytest verifier (tests/test.sh) that writes reward.txt; test files are copied in only at scoring time.

run: docker build -t dsbase-venv312:local base_image/
needs: Docker and a locally built base image
validated: Pass rates measured per model over 36,144 counting trials, and each task has a reference solution checked against its verifier.

name: SystemVerilog-RL-12k
summary: Write a self-checking SystemVerilog testbench that passes on the golden design and fails on mutated versions of it.

reward.note: A testbench must pass on the golden design and fail on the Yosys-generated mutants, run with Icarus Verilog or Verilator.

name: Quant Desk (OpenEnv Arena)
summary: Read a small brief such as a log, invoice or ruleset, compute the exact value requested and reply with one JSON answer.

reward.note: Each answer is graded by a per-task grader (integer, numeric tolerance, choice, set F1, JSON fields or string); the final reward is the best of up to three attempts.

name: Beam-DD
summary: Answer due-diligence questions over synthetic company data rooms from a shell and write answer.json with value, status and citations.

reward.note: grade.py scores 0.7 for correctness and 0.3 for citations, and trap questions require abstention.

validated: Each task ships an oracle solution; splits rebuild byte for byte from fixed seeds.

name: TradeOpsSim
summary: Reconcile a delayed execution, a repeated delivery and an interrupted cancellation in a synthetic trading operations workflow without inventing evidence.

reward.note: An evaluator checks immutable source evidence separately; a correctly escalated unresolved case can pass, and model tasks need an error-free agent response.

needs: Docker; host-CLI bundle needs the source runner

name: MathConstructOptimize-Envs
summary: Construct a mathematical object, such as a colouring, design or point configuration, that satisfies stated conditions or optimises an objective.
good_for: RL with verifiable rewards beyond final answers

reward.note: A deterministic checker accepts any valid object; construct gives 1 or 0, optimize gives 0 if invalid else 0.1 + 0.9 times progress from a baseline to best known.

needs: Python 3.10+ with numpy, scipy, sympy, networkx
validated: Checkers were re-implemented and hardened, with upstream verifier bugs found and fixed.

name: MathConstructOptimize-Envs (Harbor)
summary: Produce a valid mathematical construction or best-effort optimum and write it to answer.json in a sandboxed Harbor task.
good_for: sandboxed RL on construct and optimize tasks

reward.note: tests/test.sh runs run.py and check.py and writes reward.txt; construct is 1 if valid, optimize is at least 0.1 if valid.

run:
uv tool install harbor
huggingface-cli download amphora/MathConstructOptimize-Envs-harbor --repo-type dataset --local-dir mcoe
harbor run -p mcoe/tasks -a oracle -n 16          # validate: every task scores > 0
harbor run -p mcoe/tasks -a terminus-2 -m <model> -n 16
needs: Docker; raise Docker address pools above about 30 concurrent trials
validated: The oracle agent passes all 3,793 tasks and a no-op agent scores 0.

name: KlinikeBench
summary: Act as the clinician: interview an LLM-simulated patient, use chart, lab and imaging tools through a clinic CLI, and record a diagnosis.
good_for: RL on consultation tasks (SFT then GRPO)

reward.note: Four gates are scored (diagnosis, required tools, parameterised actions, LLM-judged must-ask coverage); outcome mode gives 1 only if all pass, multigate gives a weighted fraction.

run:
export OPENAI_API_KEY=...                    # patient simulator + must-ask judge
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/anon-caa-neurips/klinikebench \
  -a terminus-2 -m <provider/model>
needs: Docker and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for patient simulator and judge
validated: A scripted oracle scores 1.0; the paper trains Qwen3-4B with SFT then GRPO on 283 tasks and evaluates on 50 held out.

name: TextCraft-Synth
summary: Craft target items from a starting inventory through recipes up to 12 levels deep in a text crafting game played via a textcraft command.

reward.note: The verifier replays the agent's action log with its own copy of the game and gives 1.0 only if every move is legal, the targets are crafted and the log ends with finish.

run: harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/apurvaga/textcraft-synth --dataset textcraft-synth-val@1.0 --agent oracle
validated: The oracle runs each reference solution and scores 1 on every task; the nop agent scores 0.

name: Escalation-safe agent (blocked data tasks)
summary: Fetch one public number from a simulated data provider that may block you, taking only the legitimate route or ending with an honest BLOCKED reason.

reward.note: The card describes solvable and unsolvable tasks with planted temptations and says right-answer-only reward can teach exploitation; the exact reward formula is not shown.

name: Club Mix
summary: Solve 50 hard technical tasks across five environments using shell commands, then submit for the task's own verifier.

reward.note: Each verifier's raw score is mapped to [0, 1] by a hyperbolic calibration, with the frontier agent's result scoring 0.4 and beating it scoring up to 1.0.

name: Club Software
summary: Complete 15 toned-down software tasks: match a hidden dialect interpreter, shrink QPACK encodings, or rewrite a PostgreSQL query for lower cost.

reward.note: Each verifier's raw score is mapped to [0, 1] with a hyperbolic calibration between two anchors per task; SQL rewrite uses the grader's own 0 to 1 quality score.

name: CareRules
summary: Check a child care centre parent handbook against a state's licensing rules and flag conflicts and missing policies with verbatim quotes.

reward.note: Every quote from the handbook and the rules is checked word for word by a plain program; planted conflicts and deleted policies measure detection.

validated: In a planted-defect test Beam 1.0 flagged 40 of 40 planted conflicts and caught 24 of 24 deleted policies.

summary: Act as a Swedish government case officer and propose a decision, such as grant, reject or appeal outcome, with reasons and legal provisions.
good_for: RL with verifiable rewards in Swedish

reward.note: Plain Python reward functions score the outcome, amounts, reason codes and provisions; CSN cases weight outcome 0.35 and citing a non-existent paragraph zeroes the provisions part.

name: OpenAI Math Lemmas
summary: Prove one missing Lean 4 lemma by replacing a single sorry in Submission.lean, using supplied definitions and earlier lemmas.

reward.note: The FineEnvs verifier returns 1 for an accepted proof of the unchanged statement and 0 otherwise, using Comparator checks and Lean kernel replay.

python runtime/snapshot.py
SNAP=$(python runtime/snapshot.py --print-name)

harbor run -p tasks -e daytona --ek snapshot_template_name="$SNAP" \
  -a oracle -i honeycomb-free-energy--oai-honeycombforce-mem-neighbors-iff-119adcf5c8

reward.note: Tasks have code checks and some have an agent judge criteria run; a trial passes when its reward is 1.

validated: Each task ships a working solution that the oracle agent applies and checks.

name: Mathematical Reasoning Dataset and RL Environments
summary: Solve school-level maths questions from 70 modules in English or Russian and give a final answer checked against a private reference.

reward.note: The checker scores 1 for a correct final answer and 0 otherwise, using exact numbers, symbolic polynomials, sets and required forms, without an LLM judge.

uv run --extra verifiers vf-eval mathematics-rl \
  --env.taskset.language ru --env.taskset.mode interpolate \
  --env.taskset.modules '["arithmetic__add_or_sub"]' \
  --model YOUR_MODEL --client.base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000
needs: An OpenAI-compatible model endpoint; Linux, macOS or WSL
validated: Docker checks cover all 70 modules in both languages with scripted answers; no model-quality or RL improvement is claimed.
